scope: Independent NumPy CPU audit; no changes to target source; bounded diagnostic, not a fresh full confirmation.
gates: Original chamber final>=.9; stable-pair probes>=.95; late arousal<=.2; >=.9 share over live lives; median reversal lag<=150; crashes remain failures. Only one exposure and three seeds: diagnostic gate, no general reliability inference.

CAT.input: loss=1-final optimal-action fraction, phase B and returned A separately, paired by seed

ablations.memory-only: freeze actor policy learning; graph and critic retained

CAT.output: penalty and sign; all individual values and mean
CAT.criterion: positive penalty means removal hurt in this sample; no significance or universal necessity claim

RHINO.input: baseline=stable-pair probe fraction during first A; after=stable-pair fraction in B or returned A
RHINO.output: retention with raw baseline and after
RHINO.criterion: ratio alone is insufficient; after must also satisfy original .95 absolute floor; zero-baseline is uninformative

remaining_zoo: Applicability review, no synthetic measurements or universal 46/46 verdict; numerical adapters not a proof of full Lean equivalence.
work: Record whole-life wall time, routine/aroused/learning/probe/refused sweeps, memory activity and checkpoint overhead separately. No energy or normalized hardware superiority claim.
tests: Focused upstream numerical/feedback/qualification/memory/composed-acquisition/policy-credit suite; report optional-backend skips. Do not retune on failures.
provenance: Preserve commands, test output, receipt, operation inputs/outputs; current-source verify and git clean check.
